name: crosspost-mcp
description: Cross-post to X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Threads from Claude. Write once, publish everywhere.
long_description: CrossPost lets you publish and schedule social media posts across multiple platforms directly from Claude. Connect your accounts on the CrossPost dashboard, then use natural language to create posts, check their status, and manage your publishing schedule — all without leaving your AI assistant.

api_key.title: CrossPost API Key
api_key.description: Your API key from the CrossPost dashboard (Settings → API Keys)

api_url.title: CrossPost API URL
api_url.description: The CrossPost server URL (leave default unless self-hosting)

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all connected social media accounts and their status

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create and publish or schedule a post across social media platforms

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List recent posts with their status across all platforms

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get detailed status of a specific post

tools.name: cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel all pending or scheduled variants of a post

tools.name: reschedule_post
tools.description: Move a scheduled post to a new time
